title: [4.7] Mouse capturing still does not work on embedded windows on Wayland
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `4.7.2.stable` and earlier `4.7` snapshots.
- Not reproducible in: `4.8.dev2` and later `4.8` snapshots.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:26.11 26.11 (Zokor) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 550 / 550 Series (RADV POLARIS12) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700F (20 threads) - 15.45 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

This is a rehash of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114044.

So, the following PR that should've fixed this bug was [cherry-picked](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/53aaf6a0efb1f3f5fec0e04db60c964b5460ead9) for [`4.7.2`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/tag/4.7.2-stable):

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120647

But the bug described in this issue still persists anyways. After some investigation, it turns out that this other PR plays a critical role in fixing the bug:

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120831

But it was [not cherry-picked](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commits/4.7.2-stable/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_embedder.cpp) for [`4.7.2`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/tag/4.7.2-stable). I tested and applied the above PR to [`4.7.2`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/tag/4.7.2-stable) and it fixed the bug for me. 

Could we have a new hotfix release for this?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the minimal reproduction project below
2. Enable "Embed Game on Next Play" in the game view window
3. Enable `run/platforms/linuxbsd/prefer_wayland` in your editor settings
4. Run the project

The game will try to capture your mouse, but it will fail on affected versions.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/musjj/pointer-capture-bug
